title: Internship-Research & Platform Testing
description:
**About NITARYA**

NITARYA helps individuals and families make informed property and global living decisions. We research countries, cities, and localities to support decisions about where and how to own property.

**About the role**

We are looking for a careful, dependable intern to research locations, update our internal knowledge platform, and test its functionality and ease of use.

This role suits someone who enjoys investigating information, organising details, and spotting things that are missing, confusing, or broken. Your work will directly support our research and help improve the platform alongside the founder and developer.

**Key responsibilities**

* Research countries, cities, and localities using assigned topics and templates, covering property markets, ownership rules, infrastructure, connectivity, and lifestyle.
* Find information from government websites, official authorities, and credible publications. Write clear summaries and record source links and relevant dates.
* Enter and update information accurately. Check names, figures, currencies, and units; flag missing, outdated, duplicate, or conflicting information.
* Test workflows across the admin panel, including the Library, Reports, forms, uploads, search, filters, editing, saving, and retrieving records.
* Identify confusing labels, unclear instructions, unnecessary steps, and missing confirmation or error messages. Suggest practical improvements.
* Check that reports generate and download correctly, include the selected information, and display without missing sections, broken tables, or overlapping text.
* Document issues with screenshots, steps to reproduce, and expected versus actual results. Maintain an issue tracker and retest fixes.
* Join scheduled screen\-sharing sessions and coordinate during agreed working hours to investigate issues and verify fixes promptly.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* Strong online research skills and the ability to assess source credibility.
* Clear written English and the ability to summarise information accurately.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Attention to detail, logical thinking, and careful observation.
* Ability to follow testing checklists and explain problems clearly.
* Dependable follow\-through, timely communication, and comfort with repetitive checks.
* Access to a laptop or desktop, reliable internet, and availability for live collaboration.

Students and recent graduates from any discipline may apply. Previous experience in research, data management, or manual software testing is helpful but not mandatory.

AI tools may assist your work, but information must be checked against original sources before submission.

**Role boundaries**

This internship covers research collection, data accuracy, functional testing, and usability feedback. Coding and fixing software errors are not required. An experienced reviewer will assess legal or tax interpretations, research conclusions, advisory recommendations, and the substantive quality of reports.

**What you will gain**

* Practical experience in structured location and property research.
* Hands\-on exposure to functional and usability testing.
* Experience documenting issues and verifying fixes with a founder and developer.
* An understanding of how research supports real client decisions.

**Who should apply**

Apply if you can commit to the full internship duration and agreed working hours, work carefully without constant supervision, and remain consistent through detailed research and repeated testing.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical exercise covering research accuracy and platform testing.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* What is your earliest joining date, how many months can you commit, and what hours are you available for live collaboration? Confirm access to a computer and reliable internet.
* Two websites give conflicting information about a country’s property ownership rules. How would you decide what to enter into our system?
* A form displays “Saved successfully,” but the record does not appear. What would you check, and what would you include in your issue report?
* Can you visit the office atleast once a week?

title: Senior Application Transition Manager
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


This is a high\-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI\-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.


We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end\-to\-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi\-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations

* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
